written: 2026-10-24, before any model saw the units
by: the session that designed the pilot (e223eaa7), from reading the code; not independent of it
rule: A member does the group's job itself. A related unit touches the job (delegates to it, consumes its result, holds it inside a string) and is neither a hit nor a miss.

groups.job: turn a text value such as "(1,234.50)" or "$5" into a number, reading parentheses as negative
groups.evidence: pvNum and parseNum strip the same decoration and read parentheses the same way; they differ on validation ("0x1F" is NaN to one and 31 to the other). pvFnSrc writes a third copy into the source of a saved recipe, as a string, so the parser cannot see it as a function.

groups.job: describe each column of a table of rows: its type, how often it is filled, its distinct values
groups.evidence: Three engines profile columns: the workbench's Profile view, the explorer's DataProfile.analyze, and xlsx.js profileColumns. xlsx-extract's profileRows delegates to profileColumns. json-explorer's analyze counts JSON node types, a neighbouring job.

groups.job: group rows by the values of chosen columns and total a measure per group (a pivot)
groups.evidence: pvTree, renderPivotTable and renderPivot each build the groups and accumulate the measure themselves. They disagree on a measure that will not parse: pvTree skips the row and reports the count, renderPivotTable adds it as zero. report-layout.js draws a partition the workbench computed, so it is related as a whole file.

groups.job: create a DOM element from a tag, an attribute object and children
groups.evidence: Four h() helpers; jscpd found three of them as clones.

groups.job: split one CSV line into fields, honouring quotes and doubled quotes
turn CSV text into records keyed by the header row
scroll a horizontal snap strip so slide i is in view, clamping i to the slides there are
groups.evidence: swipe-deck's go is the kit's; the three components hand-build the same move beside it, which the UI inventory's hand_snap signature flags.

groups.job: work out which slide of a snap strip is showing from its scroll position
groups.evidence: here-view divides scrollLeft by the strip width; user-call-form takes the panel nearest the strip's left edge.
